newsitem.title: USA: Missouri unemployment down 0.2 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Missouri unemployment down 0.2 pct in March.

text.p: Missouri's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate dropped 0.2 percent to 4.2 percent in March, the lowest seasonally adjusted monthly rate since the late 1970s, Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations said Friday.
Estimated employment increased 12,400 in March to more than 2.7 million, with early spring seasonal gains in retail trade, tourism, construction and agricultural services, the department reported.
The overall unemployment rate dropped 0.5 percent to 4.4 percent in March due primarily to improved weather and other seasonal conditions, the department reported.
The unemployment rate dropped 0.3 percent over a year ago, the department reported.
